chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2:**

Three operations
 must
 be accomplished by Divine
 Wisdom out
 of necessity. There
 is
 no other way, nor can
 they
 be
 left unf
ulfilled,
 for
 the
 self
hood in
 its falsity and evil —
 which has set
 itself against the Divine from
 the
 very
 origin
 — must be restrained by
 them
. Because
 evil stands
 in
 perpet
ual opposition to wisdom
, these
 three works
 cannot remain
 undone.

**¶3
:**
The first
 operation
 is this
: a
 regenerated natural mind, lumin
ous with
 heav
enly intelligence
, is
 established and
 built over
 the old unregenerate mind
 —
 that
 former
 external state
 which was alien
 to heaven,
 upon
 which the new
 understanding
 is
 founded
.


**¶4:**
The
 second operation is
 this: the regener
ated mind becomes
 the permanent
 enclosure and contain
ment of infernal self-love —
 that consuming
 desire
 which is
 the very
 companion and
 instrument
 of the selfhood in
 its opposition
 to the Divine.


**¶5:**
The
 third operation concerns
 all
 perv
erted affections that have been judged
 according to the quality of their works.
 Grief
 is
 pronounced
 over
 them;
 they are condemned by
 the ev
ils
 they enacted
, and therefore
 they are fixed
 permanently
 upon the selfhood itself
 — bound
 to the
 very
 thing that exalted itself against the
 Divine.
 Evil
 is made
 to bear
 its
 own nature
.

**¶6:**

This
 final consolidated
 mass
 of
 evil is sealed shut
 when
 every
 derivative
 falsity,
 every phantasm and
 sem
blance of every kind,
 is permanently fixed within it
. All
 such
 things
 are bound by this last spiritual
 restra
int for
 eternity,
 and
 are reduced
 to the lowest and most servile condition
 — made
 subordin
ate to the contain
ment that
 impris
ons the
 selfhood.
 And
 this enc
losure is set
 as a permanent
 boundary and
 an
 im
passable void between fals
ity and evil, so that they can
 no
 longer conjoin with
 one
 another, nor can their
 infl
ux pass
 between
 them. Rather
, they become bar
ren and imp
otent, being
 separated from
 one
 another forever —
 for
 when
 falsity cannot
 reach evil, and evil cannot reach fals
ity, neither
 can propag
ate further harm
,
 and both
 are rendered
 etern
ally sterile.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the darkness, the enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.
Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [of darkness that lies beneath] it, namely that alien body [upon which it was] built upon it.
The second thing is this: They will [build] and they [will fashion] the new earth, the coffin [and the enclosure] of the dark fire, the companion of the enemy.

The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [judged and there was pronounced] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the enemy, he who had raised himself up against the greatness.

They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [of darkness] which is the prison of the enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the darkness and the enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.
